```yaml
name: Debug Push Permissions
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  debug-push-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Log Environment Details
        run: |
          echo "Repository: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "Branch: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "Event: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "Actor: ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "Workflow: ${{ github.workflow }}"
          echo "Run ID: ${{ github.run_id }}"
          echo "Run Number: ${{ github.run_number }}"
          echo "SHA: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "Ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "Head Ref: ${{ github.head_ref }}"
          echo "Base Ref: ${{ github.base_ref }}"

      - name: Check Git Configuration
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git remote -v
          git status

      - name: Verify Authentication
        run: |
          echo "GitHub Token (masked): ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          echo "Token permissions:"
          echo "  Contents: ${{ contains(github.token_scopes, 'contents') }}"
          echo "  Push: ${{ contains(github.token_scopes, 'push') }}"
          echo "  Admin: ${{ contains(github.token_scopes, 'admin') }}"

      - name: Show Branch Protection Rules
        run: |
          echo "Checking branch protection rules..."
          # This will show basic info about the repository
          curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
               -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
               https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/branches/main/protection \
               || echo "No protection rules found or access denied"

      - name: Test Simple Commit
        run: |
          # Create a test file to verify commit capability
          echo "Debug test file created at $(date)" > debug-test.txt
          echo "Test file content:"
          cat debug-test.txt
          
      - name: Attempt Auto Commit (Debug)
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "debug: test commit for permission check"
          branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          skip_dirty_check: true
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Final Status Check
        run: |
          echo "Workflow completed with status: ${{ job.status }}"
          echo "Job completed at: $(date)"
```
